scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-netherlands-indies in the 1878 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.locator: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/aourednik/historical-basemaps@master/geojson/world_1878.geojson; file SHA256 e792520cd24cfb77b117d41533a59b0a5b82fc53a291fff1549ddc73e7f9a8b2; geometry SHA256 41a103cdc9c30bf092af44707128236c07c74249507f1ec6246f7ffa8399e3dc; map IDs entity-netherlands-indies
evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 1689894.1132693423 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
